description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/user_scenario.txt to understand Li Wei's dilemma about leaving his corporate job to pursue his AI startup. (2) Discover and apply the 6-step Cognition Unblocker workflow from SKILL.md — critically: Step 2 must decompose the problem into EXACTLY three named layers (表层问题, 深层原因, 核心矛盾); Step 3 must produce at least 3 distinct named perspectives (e.g., 成本视角, 收益/长期视角, 人性/心理视角); Step 4 must enumerate 3-6 plans each containing ALL FIVE required sub-fields (方案描述, 成本, 风险, 成功率 using 高/中/低 or percentages, 适配场景) and MUST cover all three plan archetypes (直接型/立刻行动, 折中型/小步试错, 暂缓/观望型); Step 5 must produce a phased execution path with stages, concrete steps, 注意事项, AND 风险与止损建议 — and must preserve user agency by inviting the user to choose; Step 6 must include a light wrap-up offering continued support. The agent must NOT use the misleading old_decision_template.md structure (simple pros/cons table) and must NOT produce a generic recommendation without the proprietary field structure. All content must reference Li Wei's specific scenario (salary, MRR, mortgage, timeline).
